The stochastic nature arises from the randomness of content generation and algorithmic curation. The 30-item deduplication protocol ensures that each item is unique within the dataset by cross-referencing against known indices. This process is critical for maintaining data integrity in the absence of explicit identifiers. The read-only state machine enforces a constraint on user behavior, ensuring that no modifications occur during the sweep. The failure mode at 9:37 AM, when browser tabs are lost, introduces a temporal discontinuity that disrupts the continuity of the stochastic process. The state machine then becomes invalid as it cannot track further transitions. The protocol's robustness depends on the consistency of the shared registers and the integrity of the browser session.
